fields.name: vaultId
docs: Global vault id used in the PDA seeds.

fields.name: circuitBreakerActive
docs: Circuit breaker. When `true`, privileged actions are halted. Activated
by `roles.cb_trigger`; disabling requires `roles.curator`.

fields.name: tranchingEnabled
docs: Indicates that a vault-scoped tranche state PDA owns junior/senior data.

fields.name: lossesEnabled
docs: Allows consensus-oracle NAV updates below the vault's current TVL.

fields.name: paddingBool
docs: Reserved padding (previously `apy_settle_skip`). Kept as a field to
preserve the on-chain account layout for already-deployed vaults.

fields.name: mint
docs: Share mint owned by the vault.

fields.name: holdings
docs: Mints this vault is currently holding, with cached pricing.

fields.name: externalLiquidity
docs: Fixed-size external liquidity payload slots. Each slot is interpreted by
its embedded `ExternalLiquiditySource` discriminator.

fields.name: mintTokenProgram
docs: Token program of `mint` (SPL Token or Token-2022). Set at vault creation
from the share mint's owner. Carved from the start of the former trailing
padding so offsets of all prior fields stay stable.

fields.name: data
docs: Oracle payload area. Interpreted by `oracle_type`.

fields.name: lastSettledTs
docs: Last NAV settlement timestamp.

fields.name: seniorApyAnchorSharePrice
docs: Senior share price at the start of the current APY regime.

fields.name: seniorApyAnchorTs
docs: Unix timestamp when the senior APY anchor was set.

fields.name: queueId
docs: Unique queue ID (u8, per user per bank) allowing up to 256 pending withdrawals

fields.name: owner
docs: The user who owns this queue entry

fields.name: bank
docs: The bank this queue entry is associated with

fields.name: escrowMint
docs: The mint of the token locked in this queue (e.g. junior tranche share token)

fields.name: targetMint
docs: The mint of the token the user will receive upon fulfillment (e.g. USD*)

fields.name: payer
docs: The account that funded the rent for this queue entry.
Receives the rent refund when the queue is closed upon fulfillment.

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount locked in this queue entry (e.g. junior share tokens)

fields.name: requestTs
docs: Timestamp when the withdrawal was requested

fields.name: expiryTs
docs: Timestamp when the lockup expires and the withdrawal can be fulfilled

fields.name: mintFeesOwed
docs: Outstanding mint fees, in vault accounting units.

fields.name: mintFeesCollected
docs: Lifetime mint fees accrued, in vault accounting units.

fields.name: burnFeesOwed
docs: Outstanding burn fees, in vault accounting units.

fields.name: burnFeesCollected
docs: Lifetime burn fees accrued, in vault accounting units.

fields.name: performanceFeesOwed
docs: Outstanding curator performance fees, in vault accounting units.

fields.name: performanceFeesCollected
docs: Lifetime curator performance fees accrued, in vault accounting units.

fields.name: protocolFeesOwed
docs: Outstanding protocol fees, in vault accounting units.

fields.name: protocolFeesCollected
docs: Lifetime protocol fees accrued, in vault accounting units.

fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: supply
docs: Total supply of tokens.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.

fields.name: isInitialized
docs: Is `true` if this structure has been initialized.

fields.name: freezeAuthority
docs: Optional authority to freeze token accounts.

definedTypes.name: apyconfig
docs: APY targets and deficit tracking.
Expected share price at time `t` is computed from the durable anchor:
expected = anchor_share_price * (1 + fixed_apy_bps/10_000)^((t - anchor_ts)/YEAR)
The anchor must be reset whenever any of the following change:
- `fixed_apy_bps`
- the performance fee (`VaultFees::performance_fee_bps`)

fields.name: fixedApyBps
docs: Curator-set target APY, in basis points.

fields.name: maxApyBps
docs: Maximum annualized APY accepted between oracle NAV updates, in basis
points.

fields.name: anchorSharePrice
docs: Share price at the start of the current accrual window.

fields.name: anchorTs
docs: Unix timestamp when the anchor was set.

fields.name: lastSettledTs
docs: Last time deficit/surplus was settled into the accrued totals
(incremental update without re-anchoring).

fields.name: accruedApyBalance
docs: Current divergence between holdings-derived NAV and the fixed-APY target,
in the same accounting unit as `VaultAccounting::tvl`: positive means
holdings are above target; negative means they are below target.
Used in two cases:
1. APY tracking when `fixed_apy_bps` is set -- the
difference between expected NAV and actual holdings-derived NAV is
recorded here on each settlement.
2. NAV reconciliation regardless of APY settings -- when the oracle's
settled NAV diverges from the booked `VaultAccounting::tvl`, the
difference accrues here (oracle NAV above book = surplus; below =
deficit).

fields.name: priceOracleAccount
docs: Account the price must be read from (Pyth `PriceUpdateV2` or Perena
vault). Must equal the supplied `oracle_account`.

definedTypes.name: cpiMapping
docs: Mapping for extracting accounts from `remaining_accounts` across multiple CPIs.
This struct enables efficient multi-CPI transactions by:
1. Deduplicating all accounts into a single `remaining_accounts` pool
2. Storing all indices for all CPIs in a single flattened vector
3. Using `lengths` to slice the indices for each individual CPI
# Example
For 2 CPIs where CPI 0 needs 10 accounts and CPI 1 needs 8 accounts:
```text
lengths: [10, 8]
CPI 0 uses indices[0..10]
CPI 1 uses indices[10..18]

fields.name: indices
docs: All indices into `remaining_accounts`, flattened across all CPIs.

fields.name: lengths
docs: Number of accounts for each CPI call.

definedTypes.name: cpiRefs
docs: References for CPI invocations.
This structure contains all the information needed to invoke CPIs
from a pool of deduplicated accounts.
# Fields
- `accounts`: Mapping of account indices per CPI slot (first = program)
- `types`: Index into `CPI_REGISTRY` for each CPI slot
- `args`: Packed CPI args buffer (u16-length-prefixed per slot)
# Convention
The **first account** in each CPI slot's account list is the **program**.
This is validated during invocation against the registry entry.
# Example
```text
CpiRefs {
accounts: CpiMapping {
lengths: [6, 5],
types: [0, 2],  // CPI 0 = PERENA_MINT, CPI 1 = JUPITER_SWAP
args: [16, 0, ..16 bytes.., 0xFF, 0xFF],

fields.name: accounts
docs: Account indices per CPI (first account of each CPI = program).

fields.name: types
docs: Index into `CPI_REGISTRY` for each CPI slot.

fields.name: args
docs: Packed CPI args — `[u16 LE length][data]` per slot.
0xFFFF = skip (program-provided), 0 = no-args, N = N bytes of client data.

fields.name: priceOracleType
docs: Oracle backing the new holding: `1` = ConsensusOracle, `2` = Pyth,
`3` = PerenaVault. `None` (`0`) is rejected — every holding is oracle-priced.

display.label: Price Source Type (1 consensus, 2 Pyth, 3 Perena vault)

fields.name: priceOracleAccount
docs: Price-source account when `price_oracle_type` is Pyth/PerenaVault (the
`PriceUpdateV2` or nested vault). Ignored for ConsensusOracle.

definedTypes.name: externalLiquiditySource
docs: External liquidity source backing a typed vault external-liquidity slot.
Numeric layout is part of the on-chain account format -- only append new
variants; never reorder or remove.

definedTypes.name: instructionRefs
docs: Top-level references for an instruction.
Bundles CPI refs (accounts, types, args) with tracked account indices.
Passed as an instruction argument from TypeScript.

fields.name: cpi
docs: CPI account mapping, type indices, and packed args.

fields.name: tracked
docs: Indices into `remaining_accounts` for direct access.

fields.name: migrateAmount
docs: Reserved for partial migration; partial migration is unsupported, so this
must be `None` (a full vault migration). A `Some(_)` value is rejected.

definedTypes.name: priceOracleType
docs: Per-asset price source. Distinct from [`VaultOracleType`], which selects the
oracle backing the vault as a whole.
Numeric layout is part of the on-chain account format — only append new
variants; never reorder or remove.

fields.name: priceOracleAccount
docs: Price-source account to bind to (Pyth `PriceUpdateV2` or Perena vault).
Required (non-default) for Pyth/PerenaVault; ignored for ConsensusOracle.

fields.name: priceStalenessThresholdSecs
docs: Asset-price staleness window, in seconds. Must be in
`1..=MAX_PRICE_STALENESS_THRESHOLD_SECS`.

fields.name: userBurnLimit
docs: Rolling cap on user share redemptions (burns). `None` leaves unchanged.

fields.name: managerPullLimit
docs: Rolling cap on manager liquidity pulls. `None` leaves unchanged.

fields.name: unstakeFees
docs: Accumulated unstake fees (bank mint tokens) from standard withdrawal fulfillments

definedTypes.name: timelockState
docs: Pod-friendly storage for a [`crate::traits::Timelocked`] implementor.
Embed in any account whose privileged mutations should require a cooldown,
then hand-write `impl Timelocked` delegating to this field.

fields.name: timeCreatedTs
docs: Creation timestamp the cooldowns are measured from. `0` means the
timelock is disabled / not yet armed.

fields.name: touchCooldownSecs
docs: Cooldown for ordinary mutating ("touch") actions.

fields.name: cleanupCooldownSecs
docs: Cooldown before stale state can be cleaned up.

fields.name: enabled
docs: Whether the timelock is active. Disabled timelocks always allow
touches/cleanups.

fields.name: shares
docs: Total share tokens currently in circulation

fields.name: stakedAmount
docs: Total bank mint tokens actively staked in the tranche

fields.name: virtualValue
docs: Tranche's current share of TVL (in normalized base units, 6 decimals)
This tracks gains/losses for stakers

fields.name: cumulativeLossAbsorbed
docs: Cumulative losses absorbed by the tranche (in normalized base units)

fields.name: lastUpdateTs
docs: Timestamp of last accounting update

fields.name: sharePrice
docs: Price per share token in normalized base units (6 decimals).
Updated after every yield/loss distribution, stake, and unstake.

fields.name: protocolFeesAccrued
docs: Unclaimed protocol fees (in bank mint tokens) sitting in the junior escrow.
Incremented on standard-path unstakes, decremented when withdrawn by admin.

fields.name: hasReachedRecoveryThreshold
docs: Set to 1 the first time the junior staked % reaches or exceeds
`recovery_threshold_bps`. Used to switch from `bootstrap_recovery_yield_bps`
to the full `recovery_yield_bps`. Never reset after being set.

fields.name: mint
docs: The bank mint (senior token)

fields.name: sharePriceDecimals
docs: Decimals for share price (derived from share mint decimals, must match bank mint)

fields.name: baseLeverageFactor
docs: Base leverage factor with 2 decimal places (100 = 1.00x, 200 = 2.00x, 215 = 2.15x).
This is the minimum leverage when junior staked % >= target threshold.

fields.name: leverageSlope
docs: Slope for dynamic leverage increase with 2 decimal places (100 = 1, 400 = 4).
leverage = base + max(0, target% - junior%) × slope / 10000

fields.name: targetPercentStakedBps
docs: Target junior staked percentage in basis points (e.g., 2500 = 25%)
Below this threshold, leverage increases dynamically

fields.name: earlyUnstakeFeeBps
docs: Fee charged for early unstaking (instant liquidity) in basis points
(e.g., 500 = 5%). Fee remains in junior pool, rewarding remaining stakers.

fields.name: standardUnstakeFeeBps
docs: Fee charged for standard unstaking (after lockup expires) in basis points
(e.g., 50 = 0.5%). This is protocol revenue, not redistributed to stakers.

fields.name: lowStakeThresholdBps
docs: When junior staked % is below this threshold (bps), the elevated
`low_stake_fee_bps` is charged on early/instant unstakes instead of the
normal `early_unstake_fee_bps`. Standard unstakes always use
`standard_unstake_fee_bps`. Set to 0 to disable.

fields.name: lowStakeFeeBps
docs: Elevated early unstake fee (bps) applied when junior staked % < low_stake_threshold_bps.
Only applies to early/instant unstakes, not standard unstakes.

fields.name: targetLockupDurationSecs
docs: Target lockup duration in seconds. Users requesting unstake must wait this
duration before an admin can fulfill the redemption. Users can expedite
by paying the early_unstake_fee_bps. 0 means no lockup.

fields.name: recoveryYieldBps
docs: Maximum recovery yield (bps) directed to junior during wipeout recovery
(after the threshold was previously reached). The effective rate scales
proportionally: `recovery_yield_bps * min(junior%, threshold) / threshold`.
Used as a floor via max(recovery_yield, leverage_yield).
Set to 0 to disable recovery (wipeout is permanent).

fields.name: recoveryThresholdBps
docs: Junior % of TVL (bps) above which recovery allocation stops and only the
normal leverage formula applies. Also the denominator for proportional
scaling. E.g. 500 = 5%. Set to 0 for flat rate (no proportional scaling).

fields.name: bootstrapRecoveryYieldBps
docs: Lower maximum recovery yield (bps) used during the initial bootstrap
phase, i.e. before the junior stake % has ever reached
`recovery_threshold_bps`. Subject to the same proportional scaling as
`recovery_yield_bps`. Once the threshold is first crossed, the full rate
takes over automatically. Set to 0 to use `recovery_yield_bps` always.

fields.name: lowStakeFeeEnabled
docs: When true (non-zero), the low-stake elevated fee logic is active.
Disabled on tranche creation so early junior depositors are not penalised.

definedTypes.name: trancheKind
docs: How a vault's underlying assets are deployed.
Tranche receipt token class for tranched vault flows.

definedTypes.name: updateConsensusOracleArgs
docs: A consensus signer reports one or more holdings in a single call (up to one
per holding slot). Recording only writes the per-signer report; aggregated
prices/external balances are written onto the holdings once a slot reaches
quorum. NAV is NOT settled here — it is derived from the holdings and settled
separately (and permissionlessly) by `crank_nav`.

fields.name: signers
docs: The full set of signers permitted to submit consensus oracle updates.
Replaces the existing set; per-signer reports are reset.

fields.name: juniorDepositCap
docs: Maximum junior tranche value in accounting units. Zero means uncapped.

fields.name: forMigration
docs: When true, records tranche mint config without transferring mint authorities.
Used when legacy tranche mint authorities will be migrated later.

fields.name: vaultId
docs: Global vault id included in the vault PDA seeds.

fields.name: baseAssetMint
docs: The vault's base (accepted-input) asset mint. Created as a permanent base
holding at vault creation.

fields.name: tvlLimit
docs: Maximum TVL in deposit-asset base units. `0` disables the cap.

fields.name: basePriceOracleType
docs: Price oracle backing the base (strict) asset holding created at vault
creation: `1` = ConsensusOracle, `2` = Pyth, `3` = PerenaVault. `None`
(`0`) is rejected — every holding must be oracle-priced.

fields.name: basePrice
docs: Initial price of the base asset in the vault's accounting unit. Must be
non-zero so the vault is immediately usable; the oracle keeps it fresh.

fields.name: basePriceOracleAccount
docs: Price-source account for the base asset when `base_price_oracle_type` is
Pyth/PerenaVault (the `PriceUpdateV2` or nested vault).

fields.name: forMigration
docs: When true, records vault config without requiring zero share-mint supply,
curator-held mint authority, or an immediate authority transfer. Used when
the share mint is an existing legacy bank mint migrated later.

definedTypes.name: vaultFees
docs: Fee-rate configuration for a vault, in basis points. The actual fee
accounting (owed + lifetime collected, per type) lives on the per-vault
[`super::fee_vault::FeeVault`] PDA, not here.

fields.name: performanceFeeBps
docs: Curator performance fee, paid to `roles.fee_collector`.

fields.name: protocolFeeBps
docs: Protocol performance fee, paid to the hardcoded protocol wallet. Charged
on the same high-water-mark gain as `performance_fee_bps`, independently
and in addition to it. Settable only by the protocol wallet.

definedTypes.name: vaultHolding
docs: One of the underlying mints a vault is holding.

fields.name: price
docs: Latest known price of `mint` in the vault's accounting unit, fixed-point.

fields.name: tokenProgram
docs: Token program used by `mint` (SPL Token or Token-2022).

fields.name: priceOracleType
docs: Source of `price`. For `ConsensusOracle` holdings, prices come from the
vault's `ConsensusOracleData::asset_prices` slot at this holding's index.

fields.name: isBase
docs: Base (accepted-input) holding. Base mints are the vault's deposit assets;
they are never auto-cleared and gate which mints can be deposited.

fields.name: priceOracleAccount
docs: On-chain account that supplies this holding's price for its
`price_oracle_type`: the Pyth `PriceUpdateV2` account for `Pyth`, or the
nested Perena vault for `PerenaVault`. The account passed to a price
update must equal this key (cross-referenced against state), which is how
a holding is bound to the correct price source. `Pubkey::default()` for
`ConsensusOracle` holdings (priced from per-signer reports, no external
account).

fields.name: localAmount
docs: Amount currently held by vault-owned token accounts.

fields.name: externalAmount
docs: Amount deployed outside vault-owned token accounts by the manager.

fields.name: timelock
docs: Timelock guarding mutations (e.g. price-oracle changes, removal).

fields.name: lastRebalanceTs
docs: Unix timestamp of the last successful `jupiter_swap` that touched this
holding. `0` means the holding has never been rebalanced.

definedTypes.name: vaultOracleType
docs: Oracle implementation backing a vault's mint pricing. Every vault always has
an oracle, so there is no `None` variant.

definedTypes.name: vaultRoles
docs: Roles authorised to take privileged actions on a vault.

fields.name: curator
docs: Admin of the vault. Authorised to reconfigure anything -- roles, fees,
APY targets, holdings, whitelist, oracle, etc. Also the only role
permitted to *disable* the circuit breaker once tripped.

fields.name: manager
docs: Authorised to pull liquidity out of the vault and deposit it back.
Cannot reconfigure the vault.

fields.name: hwManager
docs: Hot wallet authorised to perform restricted protocol liquidity management,
such as Jupiter swaps or approved lending-protocol interactions.
Kept separate from curator authority so it can remain online without
exposing full vault configuration powers.

fields.name: cbTrigger
docs: Hot wallet authorised to *activate* the circuit breaker. Kept as a
separate signer so it can be held online for fast incident response
without exposing curator authority.

fields.name: fulfiller
docs: Hot wallet authorised to fulfill expired junior withdrawal queues.

fields.name: feeCollector
docs: Wallet that receives protocol fees at collection time (mint, burn,
performance, and tranche unstake fees). Fees are transferred directly to
this wallet's token accounts — they are not accrued on the vault PDA.

definedTypes.name: pendingVaultRoleUpdates
docs: Staged role updates that become eligible after the timelock expires.

fields.name: pendingFields
docs: Bitmask of roles with a staged update.

fields.name: lossesAccepted
docs: When false, oracle updates that would lower the vault's TVL are rejected.
Must be explicitly enabled before a loss-bearing update can proceed.

fields.name: isMigrated
docs: Set when this gen-vault's value has been migrated to a new vault account.

fields.name: value
docs: Class value denominated in the vault accounting unit.

fields.name: totalSupply
docs: Total supply of this tranche receipt mint.

fields.name: sharePrice
docs: Fixed-point class share price using `Vault::DEFAULT_MINT_SHARE_PRICE`.

fields.name: cumulativeLossAbsorbed
docs: Losses absorbed by this tranche, denominated in the vault accounting unit.

fields.name: hwmSharePrice
docs: High-water mark for this class's performance fee, in the same fixed-point
units as `share_price`. Only share-price growth above this mark is charged
a performance/protocol fee. `0` means "not yet initialized" and is lazily
set to the current share price on the next settlement (so pre-existing
accounts never retroactively pay on gains earned before this field
existed). Only the junior class charges a fee; senior is exempt.

fields.name: juniorMintTokenProgram
docs: Token program of `junior_mint` (SPL Token or Token-2022). Set at tranche
creation from the junior share mint's owner.

fields.name: seniorMintTokenProgram
docs: Token program of `senior_mint` (SPL Token or Token-2022). Set at tranche
creation from the senior share mint's owner.

fields.name: inputMint
docs: Token escrowed in the queue (e.g. tranche shares or vault shares).

fields.name: outputMint
docs: Token paid out on fulfillment (e.g. vault asset or external mint).

fields.name: owner
docs: Account that initiated the withdrawal (receives output on fulfillment).

fields.name: payer
docs: Rent payer for the queue PDA; refunded when the queue account is closed.

fields.name: tvl
docs: Total value locked, denominated in the vault's accounting unit.

fields.name: totalMintSupply
docs: Total supply of the vault's share mint.

fields.name: mintSharePrice
docs: Price per share, fixed-point.

fields.name: hwmSharePrice
docs: High-water mark for the performance fee. Only share-price growth above
this value is fee-eligible. Fee-rate changes re-anchor it to the current
share price so the new rate does not apply retroactively.

fields.name: hwmUpdatedTs
docs: Timestamp the HWM was last advanced (i.e. the last performance-fee crank
that found `mint_share_price > hwm_share_price`).

fields.name: userBurnLimit
docs: Rolling cap on user burns (share-mint redemptions) per window.

fields.name: managerPullLimit
docs: Rolling cap on manager liquidity pulls per window.

fields.name: reservedStrictAssetMint
docs: Reserved (formerly the strict deposit mint). Accepted deposit mints are
now the holdings flagged `is_base`.

fields.name: assetDecimals
docs: Decimals of the deposit asset, cached so deposit/withdraw paths don't
need to deserialize the mint account.

fields.name: tvlLimit
docs: Maximum TVL in deposit-asset base units. `0` disables the cap.

fields.name: priceStalenessThresholdSecs
docs: Per-vault asset-price staleness window, in seconds. `0` falls back to
[`super::holding::DEFAULT_PRICE_STALENESS_THRESHOLD_SECS`] (24h). Resolve
via [`super::vault::Vault::price_staleness_threshold_secs`] rather than
reading this field directly.

definedTypes.name: commonStateVaultWithdrawalLimitsRollingWithdrawalLimit
docs: Rolling-window withdrawal cap. Tracks how much has been withdrawn inside
the current window and refuses further withdrawals once `amount_in_window`
would exceed `window_limit`. The window slides forward on each withdrawal
once `now - window_start_ts >= window_duration_seconds`.

fields.name: windowStartTs
docs: Unix timestamp the current window opened.

fields.name: windowDurationSeconds
docs: Window length, in seconds (e.g. 86_400 for a daily limit).

fields.name: amountInWindow
docs: Total withdrawn inside the current window, in the vault's accounting
unit.

fields.name: windowLimit
docs: Maximum allowed `amount_in_window` before the window must roll.

definedTypes.name: commonTypesEnumsVaultType
docs: How a vault's underlying assets are deployed.
- `ProgramManaged`: the vault program holds and routes funds itself.
- `ExternallyManaged`: a manager pubkey pulls liquidity out to external
strategies and deposits it back, subject to whitelist/rolling limits.
Numeric layout is part of the on-chain account format -- only append new
variants; never reorder or remove.

fields.name: protocolFeeBps
docs: Protocol performance fee, in basis points. `0` disables the protocol fee.

definedTypes.name: consensusAssetUpdate
docs: A single per-holding report submitted by a consensus signer: the signer's
view of a holding's price and off-chain (external) balance.
Holdings are addressed by their slot index (1 byte) to keep instruction data
small. To register a brand-new consensus holding, set `mint` to its mint
(and pass the matching `asset_mint` account); the created slot's index is used
and `holding_index` is ignored. For existing holdings leave `mint` as `None`.

fields.name: depositAmount
docs: Tokens transferred from the manager into the vault's asset ATA.

fields.name: externalAmount
docs: External balance to settle on the asset mint (that mint's units).

definedTypes.name: pendingVaultRoleUpdate
docs: One staged role update. `role` is one of the `ROLE_*` bit values above.

definedTypes.name: rollingLimitConfig
docs: Rolling withdrawal-limit config applied via [`SetVaultConfigArgs`].
Both fields must be zero (disable the cap) or both non-zero (enable it).

fields.name: windowLimit
docs: Max withdrawn amount inside one window (`0` disables the cap).

fields.name: windowDurationSeconds
docs: Window length in seconds (`0` only valid when `window_limit` is also `0`).
